svg.title: One character, three modes. Developer mode, Back-end mode, Study mode
svg.desc: Developer mode: Developer at QCA since June 2026. Node.js, Express and C#/.NET day to day; React and Next.js when the project needs an interface. Back-end mode: First I think through the flow, then I write the code: well-separated layers, JWT, role-based permissions, audit trails and versioned migrations. Study mode: Studying Information Systems at UNIFACS. In my spare time: AWS, Docker and Linux — plus prototypes to test ideas. Current: Dev at QCA. Base: Salvador, Brazil. Started: 2021. Guild: UNIFACS.
